class TramDagModel: 
 78class TramDagModel:
 79    """Probabilistic causal model: one transformation model per node of the DAG."""
 80
 81    DEFAULTS_CONFIG = {
 82        "set_initial_weights": False,
 83        "debug": False,
 84        "verbose": False,
 85        "device": "auto",
 86        "initial_data": None,
 87        "overwrite_initial_weights": True,
 88        "seed": 0,
 89    }
 90
 91    DEFAULTS_FIT = {
 92        "epochs": 100,
 93        "train_list": None,
 94        "learning_rate": 0.01,
 95        "batch_size": 1000,
 96        "device": "auto",
 97        "optimizer": None,
 98        "save_linear_shifts": True,
 99        "save_simple_intercepts": True,
100        "debug": False,
101        "verbose": True,
102        "return_history": False,
103        "seed": None,
104        "epochs_per_call": None,
105        "resume": True,
106    }
107
108    def __init__(self):
109        self.debug = False
110        self.verbose = False
111        self.device = _resolve_device("auto")
112        self.params = {}
113
114    # ================================================================== construction
115
116    @classmethod
117    def from_config(cls, cfg, **kwargs):
118        """Build one model per node from a :class:`TramDagConfig`.
119
120        Keyword arguments (scalars or ``{node: value}`` dicts where it makes sense):
121        ``device``, ``seed``, ``verbose``, ``debug``, ``set_initial_weights`` (warm start of
122        intercepts/linear shifts with R ``tram::Colr`` / ``MASS::polr``), ``initial_data``
123        (training DataFrame or CSV path for the warm start), ``overwrite_initial_weights``.
124        """
125        self = cls()
126        unknown = set(kwargs) - set(cls.DEFAULTS_CONFIG)
127        if unknown:
128            raise ValueError(f"[from_config] Unknown parameter(s): {', '.join(sorted(unknown))}")
129        settings = {**cls.DEFAULTS_CONFIG, **kwargs}
130        self.cfg = cfg
131        if getattr(cfg, "CONF_DICT_PATH", None) and os.path.exists(cfg.CONF_DICT_PATH):
132            cfg.update()
133        cfg._verify_completeness()
134        if getattr(cfg, "CONF_DICT_PATH", None):
135            try:
136                cfg.save()
137            except Exception as e:  # pragma: no cover - best effort like the original
138                print(f"[WARNING] Could not save configuration: {e}")
139
140        self.debug, self.verbose = bool(settings["debug"]), bool(settings["verbose"])
141        self.device = _resolve_device(settings["device"])
142        self.nodes_dict = cfg.conf_dict["nodes"]
143        self.order = topological_order(self.nodes_dict)
144        self.structures = {n: build_node_structure(n, self.nodes_dict) for n in self.order}
145        self.settings = settings
146
147        key = jax.random.PRNGKey(int(settings["seed"] or 0))
148        keys = dict(zip(self.order, jax.random.split(key, len(self.order))))
149        with jax.default_device(self.device):
150            self.params = {n: init_node_params(keys[n], self.structures[n]) for n in self.order}
151
152        set_init = settings["set_initial_weights"]
153        for n in self.order:
154            if (set_init[n] if isinstance(set_init, dict) else set_init):
155                self.params[n] = self._r_warm_start(n, settings["initial_data"])
156
157        self.best_params = dict(self.params)
158        exp_dir = self.experiment_dir
159        if exp_dir:
160            for n in self.order:
161                path = os.path.join(exp_dir, n, _STATE_FILES["init"])
162                if settings["overwrite_initial_weights"] or not os.path.exists(path):
163                    save_params(path, self.params[n])
164        if self.verbose:
165            for n in self.order:
166                print(f"[INFO] {self.structures[n].formula()}")
167        return self
168
169    @classmethod
170    def from_directory(cls, EXPERIMENT_DIR, device="auto", debug=False, verbose=False, state="best"):
171        """Load configuration, scaling and trained parameters from an experiment directory."""
172        config_path = os.path.join(EXPERIMENT_DIR, "configuration.json")
173        if not os.path.exists(config_path):
174            raise FileNotFoundError(f"[ERROR] Config file not found at {config_path}")
175        cfg = TramDagConfig.load_json(config_path)
176        self = cls.from_config(cfg, device=device, debug=debug, verbose=verbose, overwrite_initial_weights=False)
177        minmax_path = os.path.join(EXPERIMENT_DIR, "min_max_scaling.json")
178        if not os.path.exists(minmax_path):
179            raise FileNotFoundError(f"[ERROR] MinMax file not found at {minmax_path}")
180        with open(minmax_path) as f:
181            self.minmax_dict = json.load(f)
182        for n in self.order:
183            p = self._load_state(n, "last")
184            if p is not None:
185                self.params[n] = p
186            b = self._load_state(n, state)
187            self.best_params[n] = b if b is not None else self.params[n]
188        if verbose or debug:
189            print(f"[INFO] Loaded TramDagModel from {EXPERIMENT_DIR}")
190        return self
191
192    # ================================================================== helpers
193
194    @property
195    def experiment_dir(self):
196        try:
197            return self.cfg.conf_dict["PATHS"]["EXPERIMENT_DIR"]
198        except (KeyError, TypeError, AttributeError):
199            return None
200
201    def _node_dir(self, node):
202        if not self.experiment_dir:
203            raise ValueError("No EXPERIMENT_DIR in cfg.conf_dict['PATHS'].")
204        return os.path.join(self.experiment_dir, node)
205
206    @property
207    def models(self):
208        """Node structures (kept under the old attribute name for compatibility)."""
209        return self.structures
210
211    def _minmax(self, node):
212        if not hasattr(self, "minmax_dict"):
213            raise RuntimeError(
214                "[ERROR] minmax_dict not found. Call .fit() or .load_or_compute_minmax(train_df) first."
215            )
216        return tuple(float(v) for v in self.minmax_dict[node])
217
218    def _load_state(self, node, state):
219        """Parameters of ``state`` ('best' | 'last' | 'init') from disk, or None."""
220        node_dir = self._node_dir(node)
221        template = self.params[node]
222        path = os.path.join(node_dir, _STATE_FILES[state])
223        if os.path.exists(path):
224            return load_params(path, template)
225        legacy = os.path.join(node_dir, _LEGACY_FILES[state])
226        if os.path.exists(legacy):
227            try:
228                import torch
229            except ImportError:
230                warnings.warn(f"{legacy} is a torch checkpoint; install torch to convert it.")
231                return None
232            sd = torch.load(legacy, map_location="cpu")
233            return params_from_torch_state_dict(sd, template)
234        return None
235
236    def _params_for(self, state):
237        if state == "best":
238            return self.best_params
239        if state == "last":
240            return self.params
241        if state == "init":
242            out = {}
243            for n in self.order:
244                p = self._load_state(n, "init") if self.experiment_dir else None
245                out[n] = p if p is not None else self.params[n]
246            return out
247        raise ValueError("state must be one of 'best', 'last', 'init'")
248
249    def _encode(self, df, nodes, with_target=True):
250        return {n: to_device(self.structures[n].encode_frame(df, with_target=with_target)) for n in nodes}
251
252    @staticmethod
253    def _as_frame(data):
254        if isinstance(data, pd.DataFrame):
255            return data
256        if data is None:
257            return None
258        if hasattr(data, "df") and isinstance(data.df, pd.DataFrame):  # legacy TramDagDataset
259            return data.df
260        raise TypeError(f"[ERROR] data must be a pandas DataFrame, got {type(data)}")
261
262    def _r_warm_start(self, node, initial_data):
263        """Initialise intercepts (and pure linear shifts) from R Colr/POLR estimates."""
264        from .utils.r_subprocess import fit_r_model_subprocess
265        import tempfile
266
267        if initial_data is None:
268            raise ValueError("initial_data (DataFrame or CSV path) is required when set_initial_weights=True")
269        st = self.structures[node]
270        cleanup = None
271        if hasattr(initial_data, "to_csv"):
272            fd, cleanup = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix=".csv")
273            os.close(fd)
274            initial_data.to_csv(cleanup, index=False)
275            path = cleanup
276        else:
277            path = initial_data
278        only_ls = bool(st.shifts) and all(g.is_linear and len(g.parents) == 1 for g in st.shifts)
279        covs = [g.parents[0] for g in st.shifts] if only_ls else None
280        try:
281            thetas_R, shift_coefs = fit_r_model_subprocess(
282                node, "continous" if st.target == "continuous" else "ordinal", st.n_thetas, path,
283                ls_shift_covariates=covs, debug=self.debug,
284            )
285        finally:
286            if cleanup and os.path.exists(cleanup):
287                os.remove(cleanup)
288        return apply_warm_start(self.params[node], st, thetas_R, shift_coefs if only_ls else None)
289
290    # ================================================================== scaling
291
292    def load_or_compute_minmax(self, td_train_data=None, use_existing=False, write=True):
293        """5% / 95% quantiles of the training data, used to scale continuous targets."""
294        path = os.path.join(self.experiment_dir, "min_max_scaling.json") if self.experiment_dir else None
295        if use_existing:
296            if not path or not os.path.exists(path):
297                raise FileNotFoundError(f"MinMax file not found: {path}")
298            with open(path) as f:
299                self.minmax_dict = json.load(f)
300            return self.minmax_dict
301        df = self._as_frame(td_train_data)
302        num = df.select_dtypes(include="number")  # excludes bool / categorical (only continuous targets are scaled)
303        q = num.quantile([0.05, 0.95])
304        self.minmax_dict = {c: [float(q.loc[0.05, c]), float(q.loc[0.95, c])] for c in q.columns}
305        if write and path:
306            os.makedirs(self.experiment_dir, exist_ok=True)
307            with open(path, "w") as f:
308                json.dump(self.minmax_dict, f, indent=4)
309        return self.minmax_dict
310
311    # ================================================================== fit
312
313    def fit(self, train_data, val_data=None, **kwargs):
314        """Train all (or ``train_list``) node models jointly.
315
316        Main options: ``epochs``, ``learning_rate``, ``batch_size`` (each a scalar, or for
317        ``epochs``/``learning_rate`` a ``{node: value}`` dict), ``optimizer`` (an optax
318        ``GradientTransformation`` replacing Adam), ``seed``, ``verbose``, ``resume`` (continue
319        from ``last_params.npz`` and the stored histories, default True).
320        Defaults come from ``cfg.conf_dict['training']`` when present (written by the
321        configuration editor), otherwise from ``DEFAULTS_FIT``.
322        Arguments specific to torch DataLoaders (``num_workers`` ...) are accepted and ignored.
323        """
324        ignored = set(kwargs) & _IGNORED_FIT_KWARGS
325        for k in ignored:
326            kwargs.pop(k)
327        unknown = set(kwargs) - set(self.DEFAULTS_FIT)
328        if unknown:
329            raise ValueError(f"[fit] Unknown parameter(s): {', '.join(sorted(unknown))}")
330        cfg_training = {k: v for k, v in (self.cfg.conf_dict.get("training") or {}).items() if k in self.DEFAULTS_FIT}
331        s = {**self.DEFAULTS_FIT, **cfg_training, **kwargs}
332        self.verbose, self.debug = bool(s["verbose"]), bool(s["debug"])
333        if "device" in kwargs:
334            self.device = _resolve_device(s["device"])
335
336        train_df = self._as_frame(train_data)
337        val_df = self._as_frame(val_data)
338        nodes = [n for n in self.order if n in (s["train_list"] or self.order)]
339        per_node = lambda v, n: v[n] if isinstance(v, dict) else v
340
341        self.load_or_compute_minmax(train_df, use_existing=False, write=True)
342
343        # ---- resume
344        hist_old, start, remaining = {}, {}, {}
345        for n in nodes:
346            hist_old[n] = self._read_histories(n) if s["resume"] else None
347            last = self._load_state(n, "last") if (s["resume"] and self.experiment_dir) else None
348            if hist_old[n] and last is not None:
349                self.params[n] = last
350                best = self._load_state(n, "best")
351                self.best_params[n] = best if best is not None else last
352                start[n] = len(hist_old[n]["train"])
353            else:
354                hist_old[n] = None
355                start[n] = 0
356            remaining[n] = max(0, int(per_node(s["epochs"], n)) - start[n])
357            if self.verbose:
358                if remaining[n] == 0:
359                    print(f"[INFO] Node {n} already trained for {start[n]} epochs. Skipping.")
360                elif start[n]:
361                    print(f"[INFO] Node {n}: resuming at epoch {start[n]}.")
362        nodes = [n for n in nodes if remaining[n] > 0]
363        if not nodes:
364            return {} if s["return_history"] else None
365
366        if self.verbose:
367            print(f"[INFO] Training {len(nodes)} node(s) jointly on {self.device} "
368                  f"({len(train_df)} rows, batch size {s['batch_size']})")
369            for n in nodes:
370                print(f"       {self.structures[n].formula()}")
371
372        best_score = {}
373        for n in nodes:
374            h = hist_old[n]
375            if h:
376                vals = [v for v in (h["val"] if any(np.isfinite(h["val"])) else h["train"]) if np.isfinite(v)]
377                best_score[n] = min(vals) if vals else np.inf
378            else:
379                best_score[n] = np.inf
380
381        seed = s["seed"] if s["seed"] is not None else int(self.settings.get("seed") or 0) + sum(start.values())
382        with jax.default_device(self.device):
383            train_enc = self._encode(train_df, nodes)
384            val_enc = self._encode(val_df, nodes) if val_df is not None and len(val_df) else None
385            trainer = JointTrainer(
386                {n: self.structures[n] for n in nodes}, nodes, {n: self._minmax(n) for n in nodes if self.structures[n].target == "continuous"},
387                s["batch_size"], {n: per_node(s["learning_rate"], n) for n in nodes}, optimizer=s["optimizer"], seed=seed,
388            )
389            p_sub = {n: self.params[n] for n in nodes}
390            b_sub = {n: self.best_params.get(n, self.params[n]) for n in nodes}
391            p_sub, b_sub, best_score, hist = trainer.fit(
392                p_sub, train_enc, val_enc, remaining, best_params=b_sub, best_score=best_score,
393                verbose=self.verbose, epochs_per_call=s["epochs_per_call"],
394            )
395        for n in nodes:
396            self.params[n] = p_sub[n]
397            self.best_params[n] = b_sub[n]
398        self._write_fit_outputs(nodes, hist, hist_old, start, remaining, s)
399        if self.verbose:
400            print(f"[INFO] Training finished in {hist['seconds']:.1f}s")
401        if s["return_history"]:
402            return {n: (self._read_histories(n) or {}) for n in nodes}
403        return None
404
405    def _read_histories(self, node):
406        if not self.experiment_dir:
407            return None
408        d = self._node_dir(node)
409        tp, vp = os.path.join(d, "train_loss_hist.json"), os.path.join(d, "val_loss_hist.json")
410        if not (os.path.exists(tp) and os.path.exists(vp)):
411            return None
412        with open(tp) as f:
413            tr = json.load(f)
414        with open(vp) as f:
415            va = json.load(f)
416        return {"train": [float("nan") if v is None else v for v in tr], "val": [float("nan") if v is None else v for v in va]}
417
418    def _write_fit_outputs(self, nodes, hist, hist_old, start, remaining, s):
419        if not self.experiment_dir:
420            return
421        for i, n in enumerate(nodes):
422            d = self._node_dir(n)
423            os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True)
424            E = remaining[n]
425            tr = [float(v) for v in hist["train"][:E, i]]
426            va = [float(v) if np.isfinite(v) else None for v in hist["val"][:E, i]]
427            if hist_old[n]:
428                tr = list(hist_old[n]["train"]) + tr
429                va = [None if (isinstance(v, float) and not np.isfinite(v)) else v for v in hist_old[n]["val"]] + va
430            with open(os.path.join(d, "train_loss_hist.json"), "w") as f:
431                json.dump(tr, f)
432            with open(os.path.join(d, "val_loss_hist.json"), "w") as f:
433                json.dump(va, f)
434            save_params(os.path.join(d, _STATE_FILES["last"]), self.params[n])
435            save_params(os.path.join(d, _STATE_FILES["best"]), self.best_params[n])
436
437            st = self.structures[n]
438            lin = [g for g in st.shifts if g.is_linear]
439            if s["save_linear_shifts"] and lin:
440                path = os.path.join(d, "linear_shifts_all_epochs.json")
441                data = self._json_or_empty(path) if start[n] else {}
442                for e in range(E):
443                    data[f"epoch_{start[n] + e + 1}"] = {
444                        f"ls({', '.join(g.parents)})": _squeeze_list(hist["ls"][n][j][e]) for j, g in enumerate(lin)
445                    }
446                with open(path, "w") as f:
447                    json.dump(data, f)
448            if s["save_simple_intercepts"] and n in hist["si"]:
449                path = os.path.join(d, "simple_intercepts_all_epochs.json")
450                data = self._json_or_empty(path) if start[n] else {}
451                for e in range(E):
452                    data[f"epoch_{start[n] + e + 1}"] = [[float(v)] for v in hist["si"][n][e]]
453                with open(path, "w") as f:
454                    json.dump(data, f)
455
456    @staticmethod
457    def _json_or_empty(path):
458        if os.path.exists(path):
459            with open(path) as f:
460                return json.load(f)
461        return {}
462
463    # ================================================================== evaluation
464
465    def nll(self, data, variables=None, state="best"):
466        """Mean negative log-likelihood per node on ``data``."""
467        df = self._as_frame(data)
468        nodes = [n for n in self.order if variables is None or n in variables]
469        params = self._params_for(state)
470        mm = {n: self._minmax(n) for n in nodes if self.structures[n].target == "continuous"}
471        with jax.default_device(self.device):
472            fn = make_per_sample_nll(self.structures, nodes, mm)
473            out = fn({n: params[n] for n in nodes}, self._encode(df, nodes))
474        return {n: float(jnp.mean(out[n])) for n in nodes}
475
476    def get_latent(self, df, verbose=False, state="best"):
477        """Abduction: ``{node}_U = h(x | pa)`` for continuous nodes, ``{node}_U_lower/_U_upper``
478        (the latent interval of the observed class) for ordinal nodes."""
479        params = self._params_for(state)
480        cols = {}
481        with jax.default_device(self.device):
482            for n in self.order:
483                st = self.structures[n]
484                enc = self._encode(df, [n])[n]
485                int_out, shift_sum, _ = node_forward(st, params[n], enc)
486                cols[n] = df[n].to_numpy()
487                if st.target == "continuous":
488                    k_min, k_max = self._minmax(n)
489                    _, h = continuous_nll_terms(int_out, shift_sum, enc["y"], k_min, k_max)
490                    cols[f"{n}_U"] = np.asarray(h)
491                else:
492                    lo, up = ordinal_bounds(int_out, shift_sum, enc["y"])
493                    cols[f"{n}_U_lower"] = np.asarray(lo)
494                    cols[f"{n}_U_upper"] = np.asarray(up)
495        out = pd.DataFrame(cols, index=df.index)
496        if verbose:
497            print("[INFO] Final latent DataFrame shape:", out.shape)
498        return out
499
500    def transformation(self, node, df, x=None, state="best"):
501        """Evaluate ``h(x | pa)`` for the rows of ``df`` (continuous nodes).
502
503        If ``x`` (1d grid) is given, returns an array ``(len(df), len(x))`` with ``h`` evaluated on
504        the grid for each row's parents; otherwise ``h`` at the observed ``df[node]``.
505        """
506        st = self.structures[node]
507        if st.target != "continuous":
508            raise ValueError("transformation() is defined for continuous nodes; use cutpoints() for ordinal ones")
509        params = self._params_for(state)[node]
510        k_min, k_max = self._minmax(node)
511        with jax.default_device(self.device):
512            enc = to_device(st.encode_frame(df, with_target=False))
513            int_out, shift_sum, _ = node_forward(st, params, enc)
514            thetas = transform_intercepts_continuous(int_out)
515            if x is None:
516                y = jnp.asarray(df[node].to_numpy(), jnp.float32)
517                return np.asarray(h_extrapolated(thetas, y, k_min, k_max) + shift_sum)
518            grid = jnp.asarray(np.asarray(x, np.float32))
519            f = jax.vmap(lambda th, s: h_extrapolated(jnp.broadcast_to(th, (grid.shape[0], th.shape[0])), grid, k_min, k_max) + s)
520            return np.asarray(f(thetas, shift_sum))
521
522    def cutpoints(self, node, df, state="best"):
523        """Shifted cut-points ``theta_k - eta(pa)`` of an ordinal node, shape ``(len(df), K-1)``."""
524        st = self.structures[node]
525        params = self._params_for(state)[node]
526        with jax.default_device(self.device):
527            enc = to_device(st.encode_frame(df, with_target=False))
528            int_out, shift_sum, _ = node_forward(st, params, enc)
529            return np.asarray(ordinal_cutpoints(int_out) - shift_sum[:, None])
530
531    def shift_term(self, node, term=0, x=None, state="best"):
532        """Evaluate one shift network of ``node`` on input ``x`` (``(n, n_features)`` or 1d).
533
534        ``term`` is the index of the shift group or the name of (one of) its parents.
535        Example: inspect a learned complex shift ``cs(x2)`` of ``x3`` on a grid::
536
537            grid = np.linspace(-1, 1, 200)
538            plt.plot(grid, model.shift_term("x3", "x2", grid))
539        """
540        st = self.structures[node]
541        if isinstance(term, str):
542            idx = [i for i, g in enumerate(st.shifts) if term in g.parents]
543            if not idx:
544                raise KeyError(f"'{term}' is not a shift input of '{node}'")
545            term = idx[0]
546        g = st.shifts[term]
547        x = np.asarray(x, np.float32)
548        if x.ndim == 1:
549            x = x[:, None]
550        p = self._params_for(state)[node]["shifts"][term]
551        return np.asarray(get_model_spec(g.model_name).apply(p, jnp.asarray(x)))[:, 0]
552
553    # ================================================================== histories / parameters
554
555    def loss_history(self):
556        out = {}
557        for n in self.order:
558            h = self._read_histories(n)
559            out[n] = {"train": h["train"] if h else None, "validation": h["val"] if h else None}
560        return out
561
562    def linear_shift_history(self):
563        out = {}
564        for n in self.order:
565            path = os.path.join(self._node_dir(n), "linear_shifts_all_epochs.json")
566            if os.path.exists(path):
567                out[n] = pd.read_json(path)
568            elif self.debug:
569                print(f"[DEBUG] No linear shift history found for node '{n}' at {path}")
570        return out
571
572    def simple_intercept_history(self):
573        out = {}
574        for n in self.order:
575            path = os.path.join(self._node_dir(n), "simple_intercepts_all_epochs.json")
576            if os.path.exists(path):
577                out[n] = pd.read_json(path)
578            elif self.debug:
579                print(f"[DEBUG] No simple intercept history found for node '{n}' at {path}")
580        return out
581
582    def get_thetas(self, node, state="best"):
583        """Simple-intercept parameters (Bernstein coefficients or ordinal cut-points) as ``[[t1], [t2], ...]``."""
584        st = self.structures[node]
585        if not st.has_simple_intercept:
586            return None
587        w = self._params_for(state)[node]["int"][0]["w"][0]
588        th = ordinal_cutpoints(w) if st.target == "ordinal" else transform_intercepts_continuous(w)
589        return [[float(v)] for v in np.asarray(th)]
590
591    def get_linear_shifts(self, node, state="best"):
592        st = self.structures[node]
593        p = self._params_for(state)[node]
594        return {
595            f"ls({', '.join(g.parents)})": _squeeze_list(np.asarray(sp[0]["w"][:, 0]))
596            for g, sp in zip(st.shifts, p["shifts"]) if g.is_linear
597        }
598
599    def get_linear_shifts_dict(self):
600        return {s: {n: self.get_linear_shifts(n, s) for n in self.order} for s in ("best", "last", "init")}
601
602    def get_simple_intercepts_dict(self):
603        return {s: {n: self.get_thetas(n, s) for n in self.order} for s in ("best", "last", "init")}
604
605    def coefficients(self, state="best"):
606        """Tidy table of all interpretable coefficients (linear shifts per parent / one-hot level)."""
607        rows = []
608        for n in self.order:
609            st = self.structures[n]
610            p = self._params_for(state)[n]
611            for g, sp in zip(st.shifts, p["shifts"]):
612                if not g.is_linear:
613                    continue
614                w = np.asarray(sp[0]["w"][:, 0])
615                labels = []
616                for par in g.parents:
617                    k = st.parent_levels.get(par)
618                    labels += [f"{par}={i}" for i in range(k)] if k else [par]
619                for lab, v in zip(labels, w):
620                    rows.append({"node": n, "term": "ls", "input": lab, "coefficient": float(v)})
621        return pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=["node", "term", "input", "coefficient"])
622
623    def get_train_val_nll(self, node, mode):
624        h = self._read_histories(node)
625        if not h:
626            return None, None
627        tr, va = np.array(h["train"], float), np.array(h["val"], float)
628        if mode == "init":
629            i = 0
630        elif mode == "last":
631            i = len(tr) - 1
632        elif mode == "best":
633            i = int(np.nanargmin(va)) if np.isfinite(va).any() else int(np.nanargmin(tr))
634        else:
635            raise ValueError("mode must be one of 'best', 'last', 'init'")
636        return float(tr[i]), float(va[i])
637
638    def formulas(self):
639        return {n: self.structures[n].formula() for n in self.order}
640
641    # ================================================================== sampling
642
643    def sample(self, do_interventions=None, predefined_latent_samples_df=None, **kwargs):
644        """Sample from the fitted SCM.
645
646        * observational: ``model.sample(number_of_samples=10_000)``
647        * interventional: ``model.sample(do_interventions={"x1": 0.5})``
648        * counterfactual: ``u = model.get_latent(obs_df)`` then
649          ``model.sample(do_interventions={...}, predefined_latent_samples_df=u)``
650
651        Options: ``number_of_samples`` (10 000), ``number_of_counterfactual_samples`` (10 000, draws
652        per observation for ordinal latent intervals), ``seed``, ``state`` ('best'),
653        ``use_initial_weights_for_sampling``, ``save`` (write ``sampling/sampled.npy`` per node),
654        ``verbose``. Returns ``(sampled_by_node, latents_by_node)`` with numpy arrays.
655        """
656        s = {
657            "number_of_samples": 10_000,
658            "number_of_counterfactual_samples": 10_000,
659            "seed": None,
660            "state": "best",
661            "use_initial_weights_for_sampling": False,
662            "save": True,
663            "delete_all_previously_sampled": True,
664            "verbose": self.verbose,
665            "debug": False,
666            "batch_size": None,
667            "device": None,
668        }
669        unknown = set(kwargs) - set(s)
670        if unknown:
671            raise ValueError(f"[sample] Unknown parameter(s): {', '.join(sorted(unknown))}")
672        s.update(kwargs)
673        state = "init" if s["use_initial_weights_for_sampling"] else s["state"]
674        params = self._params_for(state)
675        mm = {n: self._minmax(n) for n in self.order if self.structures[n].target == "continuous"}
676        if getattr(self, "_sampler", None) is None or self._sampler.minmax != mm:
677            self._sampler = DagSampler(self.structures, self.order, params, mm)
678        sampler = self._sampler
679        sampler.params = params
680        with jax.default_device(self.device if s["device"] is None else _resolve_device(s["device"])):
681            sampled, latents, draws = sampler.sample(
682                s["number_of_samples"], do=do_interventions, latents_df=predefined_latent_samples_df,
683                n_cf=s["number_of_counterfactual_samples"], seed=s["seed"], verbose=s["verbose"] or s["debug"],
684            )
685        self.last_counterfactual_draws = draws
686        if s["save"] and self.experiment_dir:
687            for n in self.order:
688                d = os.path.join(self._node_dir(n), "sampling")
689                if s["delete_all_previously_sampled"] and os.path.isdir(d):
690                    shutil.rmtree(d)
691                os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True)
692                if isinstance(sampled[n], dict):
693                    np.savez(os.path.join(d, "hist.npz"), **sampled[n])
694                else:
695                    np.save(os.path.join(d, "sampled.npy"), sampled[n])
696                np.save(os.path.join(d, "latents.npy"), latents[n])
697                if n in draws:
698                    np.save(os.path.join(d, "draws.npy"), draws[n])
699        return sampled, latents
700
701    def load_sampled_and_latents(self, EXPERIMENT_DIR=None, nodes=None):
702        exp = EXPERIMENT_DIR or self.experiment_dir
703        sampled, latents = {}, {}
704        for n in nodes or self.order:
705            d = os.path.join(exp, n, "sampling")
706            sp, lp, hp = (os.path.join(d, f) for f in ("sampled.npy", "latents.npy", "hist.npz"))
707            if os.path.exists(sp):
708                sampled[n] = np.load(sp)
709            elif os.path.exists(hp):
710                with np.load(hp) as f:
711                    sampled[n] = dict(f)
712            else:
713                print(f"[WARNING] Missing sampling files for node '{n}' — skipping.")
714                continue
715            if os.path.exists(lp):
716                latents[n] = np.load(lp)
717        return sampled, latents
718
719    # ================================================================== plots

721    def plot_loss_history(self, variable=None):
722        import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
723
724        hist = self.loss_history()
725        nodes = [variable] if variable else list(hist)
726        nodes = [n for n in nodes if hist.get(n, {}).get("train")]
727        if not nodes:
728            print("[WARNING] No valid histories found to plot.")
729            return
730        fig, axs = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(14, 12))
731        for ax, last in zip(axs, (False, True)):
732            for n in nodes:
733                tr = np.array(hist[n]["train"], float)
734                va = np.array([np.nan if v is None else v for v in (hist[n]["validation"] or [])], float)
735                E = len(tr)
736                s0 = (E - 1 if E < 5 else int(E * 0.9)) if last else 0
737                ep = np.arange(s0 + 1, E + 1)
738                ax.plot(ep, tr[s0:], "--", label=f"{n} - train")
739                if len(va):
740                    ax.plot(ep, va[s0:], label=f"{n} - val")
741            ax.set_title("Training and Validation NLL - " + ("Last 10% of Epochs" if last else "Full History"))
742            ax.set_xlabel("Epoch")
743            ax.set_ylabel("NLL")
744            ax.legend()
745            ax.grid(True)
746        plt.tight_layout()
747        plt.show()

749    def plot_linear_shift_history(self, data_dict=None, node=None, ref_lines=None):
750        self._plot_history(data_dict or self.linear_shift_history(), node, ref_lines, "Shift Value", "Shift Term History", "")

752    def plot_simple_intercepts_history(self, data_dict=None, node=None, ref_lines=None):

755    @staticmethod
756    def _plot_history(data_dict, node, ref_lines, ylabel, title, prefix):
757        import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
758
759        for n in [node] if node else list(data_dict):
760            df = data_dict[n].copy()
761            rows = {}
762            for idx in df.index:
763                vals = [_first_scalar(v) for v in df.loc[idx]]
764                if any(isinstance(v, list) for v in df.loc[idx]) and isinstance(df.loc[idx].iloc[0], list) and len(df.loc[idx].iloc[0]) > 1:
765                    arr = np.array([np.ravel(v) for v in df.loc[idx]], float)
766                    for j in range(arr.shape[1]):
767                        rows[f"{idx}[{j}]"] = arr[:, j]
768                else:
769                    rows[f"{prefix}{idx}"] = np.array(vals, float)
770            epochs = [int(str(c).replace("epoch_", "")) for c in df.columns]
771            order = np.argsort(epochs)
772            plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
773            for lab, v in rows.items():
774                plt.plot(np.array(epochs)[order], v[order], lw=1.4, label=lab)
775            if ref_lines and n in ref_lines:
776                for v in ref_lines[n]:
777                    plt.axhline(y=v, color="k", linestyle="--", lw=1.0)
778                    plt.text(max(epochs), v, f"{n}: {v}", va="bottom", ha="right", fontsize=8)
779            plt.xlabel("Epoch")
780            plt.ylabel(ylabel)
781            plt.title(f"{title} — Node: {n}")
782            plt.legend(bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc="upper left", fontsize="small")
783            plt.tight_layout()
784            plt.show()

786    def plot_latents(self, df, variable=None, confidence=0.95, simulations=1000):
787        import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

790        lat = self.get_latent(df)
791        for n in [variable] if variable else self.order:
792            if f"{n}_U" not in lat.columns:
793                if self.verbose:

795                continue
796            sample = lat[f"{n}_U"].to_numpy()

804            axs[1].set_title(f"Latent QQ Plot ({n})")
805            plt.suptitle(f"Latent Diagnostics for Node: {n}", fontsize=14)
806            plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.03, 1, 0.95])

809    def plot_hdag(self, df, variables=None, plot_n_rows=1, **kwargs):
810        import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
811
812        for n in variables or self.order:
813            st = self.structures[n]
814            rows = df.iloc[: (1 if not st.parents else min(len(df), plot_n_rows))]
815            if st.target == "continuous":
816                k_min, k_max = self._minmax(n)
817                d = k_max - k_min
818                lo = kwargs.get("xmin_plot", k_min - 0.1 * d)
819                hi = kwargs.get("xmax_plot", k_max + 0.1 * d)
820                grid = np.linspace(lo, hi, 1000)
821                H = self.transformation(n, rows, x=grid)
822                for i in range(len(rows)):
823                    if st.parents:
824                        print(f"\n=== Sample {i+1}/{len(rows)} ===")
825                        print(rows.iloc[i])
826                    plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
827                    for mask, col, lab in (
828                        (grid < k_min, "red", "x < min_val"),
829                        ((grid >= k_min) & (grid <= k_max), "blue", "min_val <= x <= max_val"),
830                        (grid > k_max, "red", "x > max_val"),
831                    ):
832                        plt.plot(grid[mask], H[i][mask], color=col, label=lab)
833                    plt.xlabel(f" ({n})")
834                    plt.ylabel(f"h({n}|{' '.join(st.parents)})")
835                    plt.title(f"transformation function {n} — sample {i+1}")
836                    plt.grid(True)
837                    plt.legend()
838                    plt.show()
839            else:
840                C = self.cutpoints(n, rows)
841                for i in range(len(rows)):
842                    plt.figure(figsize=(6, 4))
843                    k = np.arange(1, C.shape[1] + 1)
844                    plt.plot(k, C[i], "o", color="C1", markersize=8)
845                    plt.xticks(k)
846                    plt.xlabel("Ordinal class index (k)")
847                    plt.ylabel("Shifted cutpoint (θₖ - ηᵢ)")
848                    plt.title(f"{n} — Sample {i+1}")
849                    plt.grid(True, linestyle="--", alpha=0.6)
850                    plt.tight_layout()
851                    plt.show()

853    def plot_samples_vs_true(self, df, sampled=None, variable=None, bins=100, hist_true_color="blue",
854                             hist_est_color="orange", figsize=(14, 5)):
855        import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
856        from statsmodels.graphics.gofplots import qqplot_2samples
857
858        if sampled is None:
859            sampled, _ = self.load_sampled_and_latents()
860        for n in variable or self.order:
861            if n not in sampled or n not in df.columns:
862                continue
863            sv = sampled[n]
864            if isinstance(sv, dict):
865                sv = np.repeat(sv["vals"].ravel(), sv["counts"].ravel())
866            sv = np.asarray(sv)
867            if sv.ndim == 2:
868                print(f"[INFO] CAUTION! {n}: samples are class probabilities per observation; "
869                      "the plot shows the most probable class per observation.")
870                sv = np.argmax(sv, axis=1)
871            sv = sv[np.isfinite(sv)]
872            tv = df[n].dropna().to_numpy(dtype=float)
873            tv = tv[np.isfinite(tv)]
874            fig, axs = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=figsize)
875            if self.structures[n].target == "continuous":
876                axs[0].hist(tv, bins=bins, density=True, alpha=0.6, color=hist_true_color, label=f"True {n}")
877                axs[0].hist(sv, bins=bins, density=True, alpha=0.6, color=hist_est_color, label="Sampled")
878                axs[0].set_xlabel("Value")
879                axs[0].set_ylabel("Density")
880                axs[0].set_title(f"Histogram overlay for {n}")
881                axs[0].legend()
882                axs[0].grid(True, ls="--", alpha=0.4)
883                qqplot_2samples(tv, sv, line="45", ax=axs[1])
884                axs[1].set_xlabel("True quantiles")
885                axs[1].set_ylabel("Sampled quantiles")
886                axs[1].set_title(f"QQ plot for {n}")
887                axs[1].grid(True, ls="--", alpha=0.4)
888            else:
889                u = np.union1d(np.unique(tv), np.unique(sv))
890                tc = np.array([(tv == v).sum() for v in u], float)
891                sc = np.array([(sv == v).sum() for v in u], float)
892                axs[0].bar(u - 0.2, tc / tc.sum(), width=0.4, color=hist_true_color, alpha=0.7, label="True")
893                axs[0].bar(u + 0.2, sc / sc.sum(), width=0.4, color=hist_est_color, alpha=0.7, label="Sampled")
894                axs[0].set_xticks(u)
895                axs[0].set_xlabel("Ordinal Level")
896                axs[0].set_ylabel("Relative Frequency")
897                axs[0].set_title(f"Ordinal bar plot for {n}")
898                axs[0].legend()
899                axs[0].grid(True, ls="--", alpha=0.4)
900                axs[1].axis("off")
901            plt.tight_layout()
902            plt.show()

906    def summary(self, verbose=False):
907        print("\n" + "=" * 120)
908        print(f"{'TRAM DAG MODEL SUMMARY':^120}")
909        print("=" * 120)
910        rows = []
911        for n in self.order:
912            h = self._read_histories(n)
913            bt, bv = self.get_train_val_nll(n, "best") if h else (None, None)
914            lt, lv = self.get_train_val_nll(n, "last") if h else (None, None)
915            rows.append({"Node": n, "Best Train NLL": bt, "Best Val NLL": bv, "Last Train NLL": lt,
916                         "Last Val NLL": lv, "Epochs": len(h["train"]) if h else 0})
917        print("\n[1] TRAINING METRICS OVERVIEW")
918        print("-" * 120)
919        print(pd.DataFrame(rows).round(4).to_string(index=False, justify="center", col_space=14))
920        print("-" * 120)
921        print("\n[2] NODE-SPECIFIC DETAILS")
922        print("-" * 120)
923        for n in self.order:
924            st = self.structures[n]
925            print(f"\n{f'NODE: {n}':^120}")
926            print(f"  {st.formula()}")
927            for state in ("init", "last", "best"):
928                print(f"\n  [{state.upper()} STATE]")
929                th = self.get_thetas(n, state)
930                if th is not None:
931                    arr = np.round(np.array(th).ravel(), 4)
932                    print(f"    Θ ({len(arr)}): {np.array2string(arr, max_line_width=110, separator=', ')}")
933                else:
934                    print("    Θ: complex intercept (input dependent)")
935                for k, v in self.get_linear_shifts(n, state).items():
936                    print(f"     {k}: {np.round(v, 4)}")
937            if verbose:
938                print("\n  [DETAILS]")
939                nparams = sum(int(np.prod(x.shape)) for x in jax.tree_util.tree_leaves(self.params[n]))
940                print(f"    intercept model: {st.intercept_model} ({st.n_int_features} -> {st.n_thetas})")
941                for g in st.shifts:
942                    print(f"    shift model: {g.model_name} {g.parents} ({g.n_features} -> 1)")
943                print(f"    Parameter count: {nparams:,}")
944            print("-" * 120)
945        print("=" * 120 + "\n")

@classmethod
def from_config(cls, cfg, **kwargs): 
116    @classmethod
117    def from_config(cls, cfg, **kwargs):
118        """Build one model per node from a :class:`TramDagConfig`.
119
120        Keyword arguments (scalars or ``{node: value}`` dicts where it makes sense):
121        ``device``, ``seed``, ``verbose``, ``debug``, ``set_initial_weights`` (warm start of
122        intercepts/linear shifts with R ``tram::Colr`` / ``MASS::polr``), ``initial_data``
123        (training DataFrame or CSV path for the warm start), ``overwrite_initial_weights``.
124        """
125        self = cls()
126        unknown = set(kwargs) - set(cls.DEFAULTS_CONFIG)
127        if unknown:
128            raise ValueError(f"[from_config] Unknown parameter(s): {', '.join(sorted(unknown))}")
129        settings = {**cls.DEFAULTS_CONFIG, **kwargs}
130        self.cfg = cfg
131        if getattr(cfg, "CONF_DICT_PATH", None) and os.path.exists(cfg.CONF_DICT_PATH):
132            cfg.update()
133        cfg._verify_completeness()
134        if getattr(cfg, "CONF_DICT_PATH", None):
135            try:
136                cfg.save()
137            except Exception as e:  # pragma: no cover - best effort like the original
138                print(f"[WARNING] Could not save configuration: {e}")
139
140        self.debug, self.verbose = bool(settings["debug"]), bool(settings["verbose"])
141        self.device = _resolve_device(settings["device"])
142        self.nodes_dict = cfg.conf_dict["nodes"]
143        self.order = topological_order(self.nodes_dict)
144        self.structures = {n: build_node_structure(n, self.nodes_dict) for n in self.order}
145        self.settings = settings
146
147        key = jax.random.PRNGKey(int(settings["seed"] or 0))
148        keys = dict(zip(self.order, jax.random.split(key, len(self.order))))
149        with jax.default_device(self.device):
150            self.params = {n: init_node_params(keys[n], self.structures[n]) for n in self.order}
151
152        set_init = settings["set_initial_weights"]
153        for n in self.order:
154            if (set_init[n] if isinstance(set_init, dict) else set_init):
155                self.params[n] = self._r_warm_start(n, settings["initial_data"])
156
157        self.best_params = dict(self.params)
158        exp_dir = self.experiment_dir
159        if exp_dir:
160            for n in self.order:
161                path = os.path.join(exp_dir, n, _STATE_FILES["init"])
162                if settings["overwrite_initial_weights"] or not os.path.exists(path):
163                    save_params(path, self.params[n])
164        if self.verbose:
165            for n in self.order:
166                print(f"[INFO] {self.structures[n].formula()}")
167        return self

Build one model per node from a TramDagConfig.

Keyword arguments (scalars or {node: value} dicts where it makes sense): device, seed, verbose, debug, set_initial_weights (warm start of intercepts/linear shifts with R tram::Colr / MASS::polr), initial_data (training DataFrame or CSV path for the warm start), overwrite_initial_weights.

@classmethod
def from_directory( cls, EXPERIMENT_DIR, device='auto', debug=False, verbose=False, state='best'): 
169    @classmethod
170    def from_directory(cls, EXPERIMENT_DIR, device="auto", debug=False, verbose=False, state="best"):
171        """Load configuration, scaling and trained parameters from an experiment directory."""
172        config_path = os.path.join(EXPERIMENT_DIR, "configuration.json")
173        if not os.path.exists(config_path):
174            raise FileNotFoundError(f"[ERROR] Config file not found at {config_path}")
175        cfg = TramDagConfig.load_json(config_path)
176        self = cls.from_config(cfg, device=device, debug=debug, verbose=verbose, overwrite_initial_weights=False)
177        minmax_path = os.path.join(EXPERIMENT_DIR, "min_max_scaling.json")
178        if not os.path.exists(minmax_path):
179            raise FileNotFoundError(f"[ERROR] MinMax file not found at {minmax_path}")
180        with open(minmax_path) as f:
181            self.minmax_dict = json.load(f)
182        for n in self.order:
183            p = self._load_state(n, "last")
184            if p is not None:
185                self.params[n] = p
186            b = self._load_state(n, state)
187            self.best_params[n] = b if b is not None else self.params[n]
188        if verbose or debug:
189            print(f"[INFO] Loaded TramDagModel from {EXPERIMENT_DIR}")
190        return self

def load_or_compute_minmax(self, td_train_data=None, use_existing=False, write=True): 
292    def load_or_compute_minmax(self, td_train_data=None, use_existing=False, write=True):
293        """5% / 95% quantiles of the training data, used to scale continuous targets."""
294        path = os.path.join(self.experiment_dir, "min_max_scaling.json") if self.experiment_dir else None
295        if use_existing:
296            if not path or not os.path.exists(path):
297                raise FileNotFoundError(f"MinMax file not found: {path}")
298            with open(path) as f:
299                self.minmax_dict = json.load(f)
300            return self.minmax_dict
301        df = self._as_frame(td_train_data)
302        num = df.select_dtypes(include="number")  # excludes bool / categorical (only continuous targets are scaled)
303        q = num.quantile([0.05, 0.95])
304        self.minmax_dict = {c: [float(q.loc[0.05, c]), float(q.loc[0.95, c])] for c in q.columns}
305        if write and path:
306            os.makedirs(self.experiment_dir, exist_ok=True)
307            with open(path, "w") as f:
308                json.dump(self.minmax_dict, f, indent=4)
309        return self.minmax_dict

5% / 95% quantiles of the training data, used to scale continuous targets.

def fit(self, train_data, val_data=None, **kwargs): 
313    def fit(self, train_data, val_data=None, **kwargs):
314        """Train all (or ``train_list``) node models jointly.
315
316        Main options: ``epochs``, ``learning_rate``, ``batch_size`` (each a scalar, or for
317        ``epochs``/``learning_rate`` a ``{node: value}`` dict), ``optimizer`` (an optax
318        ``GradientTransformation`` replacing Adam), ``seed``, ``verbose``, ``resume`` (continue
319        from ``last_params.npz`` and the stored histories, default True).
320        Defaults come from ``cfg.conf_dict['training']`` when present (written by the
321        configuration editor), otherwise from ``DEFAULTS_FIT``.
322        Arguments specific to torch DataLoaders (``num_workers`` ...) are accepted and ignored.
323        """
324        ignored = set(kwargs) & _IGNORED_FIT_KWARGS
325        for k in ignored:
326            kwargs.pop(k)
327        unknown = set(kwargs) - set(self.DEFAULTS_FIT)
328        if unknown:
329            raise ValueError(f"[fit] Unknown parameter(s): {', '.join(sorted(unknown))}")
330        cfg_training = {k: v for k, v in (self.cfg.conf_dict.get("training") or {}).items() if k in self.DEFAULTS_FIT}
331        s = {**self.DEFAULTS_FIT, **cfg_training, **kwargs}
332        self.verbose, self.debug = bool(s["verbose"]), bool(s["debug"])
333        if "device" in kwargs:
334            self.device = _resolve_device(s["device"])
335
336        train_df = self._as_frame(train_data)
337        val_df = self._as_frame(val_data)
338        nodes = [n for n in self.order if n in (s["train_list"] or self.order)]
339        per_node = lambda v, n: v[n] if isinstance(v, dict) else v
340
341        self.load_or_compute_minmax(train_df, use_existing=False, write=True)
342
343        # ---- resume
344        hist_old, start, remaining = {}, {}, {}
345        for n in nodes:
346            hist_old[n] = self._read_histories(n) if s["resume"] else None
347            last = self._load_state(n, "last") if (s["resume"] and self.experiment_dir) else None
348            if hist_old[n] and last is not None:
349                self.params[n] = last
350                best = self._load_state(n, "best")
351                self.best_params[n] = best if best is not None else last
352                start[n] = len(hist_old[n]["train"])
353            else:
354                hist_old[n] = None
355                start[n] = 0
356            remaining[n] = max(0, int(per_node(s["epochs"], n)) - start[n])
357            if self.verbose:
358                if remaining[n] == 0:
359                    print(f"[INFO] Node {n} already trained for {start[n]} epochs. Skipping.")
360                elif start[n]:
361                    print(f"[INFO] Node {n}: resuming at epoch {start[n]}.")
362        nodes = [n for n in nodes if remaining[n] > 0]
363        if not nodes:
364            return {} if s["return_history"] else None
365
366        if self.verbose:
367            print(f"[INFO] Training {len(nodes)} node(s) jointly on {self.device} "
368                  f"({len(train_df)} rows, batch size {s['batch_size']})")
369            for n in nodes:
370                print(f"       {self.structures[n].formula()}")
371
372        best_score = {}
373        for n in nodes:
374            h = hist_old[n]
375            if h:
376                vals = [v for v in (h["val"] if any(np.isfinite(h["val"])) else h["train"]) if np.isfinite(v)]
377                best_score[n] = min(vals) if vals else np.inf
378            else:
379                best_score[n] = np.inf
380
381        seed = s["seed"] if s["seed"] is not None else int(self.settings.get("seed") or 0) + sum(start.values())
382        with jax.default_device(self.device):
383            train_enc = self._encode(train_df, nodes)
384            val_enc = self._encode(val_df, nodes) if val_df is not None and len(val_df) else None
385            trainer = JointTrainer(
386                {n: self.structures[n] for n in nodes}, nodes, {n: self._minmax(n) for n in nodes if self.structures[n].target == "continuous"},
387                s["batch_size"], {n: per_node(s["learning_rate"], n) for n in nodes}, optimizer=s["optimizer"], seed=seed,
388            )
389            p_sub = {n: self.params[n] for n in nodes}
390            b_sub = {n: self.best_params.get(n, self.params[n]) for n in nodes}
391            p_sub, b_sub, best_score, hist = trainer.fit(
392                p_sub, train_enc, val_enc, remaining, best_params=b_sub, best_score=best_score,
393                verbose=self.verbose, epochs_per_call=s["epochs_per_call"],
394            )
395        for n in nodes:
396            self.params[n] = p_sub[n]
397            self.best_params[n] = b_sub[n]
398        self._write_fit_outputs(nodes, hist, hist_old, start, remaining, s)
399        if self.verbose:
400            print(f"[INFO] Training finished in {hist['seconds']:.1f}s")
401        if s["return_history"]:
402            return {n: (self._read_histories(n) or {}) for n in nodes}
403        return None

Train all (or train_list) node models jointly.

Main options: epochs, learning_rate, batch_size (each a scalar, or for epochs/learning_rate a {node: value} dict), optimizer (an optax GradientTransformation replacing Adam), seed, verbose, resume (continue from last_params.npz and the stored histories, default True). Defaults come from cfg.conf_dict['training'] when present (written by the configuration editor), otherwise from DEFAULTS_FIT. Arguments specific to torch DataLoaders (num_workers ...) are accepted and ignored.

def nll(self, data, variables=None, state='best'): 
465    def nll(self, data, variables=None, state="best"):
466        """Mean negative log-likelihood per node on ``data``."""
467        df = self._as_frame(data)
468        nodes = [n for n in self.order if variables is None or n in variables]
469        params = self._params_for(state)
470        mm = {n: self._minmax(n) for n in nodes if self.structures[n].target == "continuous"}
471        with jax.default_device(self.device):
472            fn = make_per_sample_nll(self.structures, nodes, mm)
473            out = fn({n: params[n] for n in nodes}, self._encode(df, nodes))
474        return {n: float(jnp.mean(out[n])) for n in nodes}

Mean negative log-likelihood per node on data.

def get_latent(self, df, verbose=False, state='best'): 
476    def get_latent(self, df, verbose=False, state="best"):
477        """Abduction: ``{node}_U = h(x | pa)`` for continuous nodes, ``{node}_U_lower/_U_upper``
478        (the latent interval of the observed class) for ordinal nodes."""
479        params = self._params_for(state)
480        cols = {}
481        with jax.default_device(self.device):
482            for n in self.order:
483                st = self.structures[n]
484                enc = self._encode(df, [n])[n]
485                int_out, shift_sum, _ = node_forward(st, params[n], enc)
486                cols[n] = df[n].to_numpy()
487                if st.target == "continuous":
488                    k_min, k_max = self._minmax(n)
489                    _, h = continuous_nll_terms(int_out, shift_sum, enc["y"], k_min, k_max)
490                    cols[f"{n}_U"] = np.asarray(h)
491                else:
492                    lo, up = ordinal_bounds(int_out, shift_sum, enc["y"])
493                    cols[f"{n}_U_lower"] = np.asarray(lo)
494                    cols[f"{n}_U_upper"] = np.asarray(up)
495        out = pd.DataFrame(cols, index=df.index)
496        if verbose:
497            print("[INFO] Final latent DataFrame shape:", out.shape)
498        return out

Abduction: {node}_U = h(x | pa) for continuous nodes, {node}_U_lower/_U_upper (the latent interval of the observed class) for ordinal nodes.

def transformation(self, node, df, x=None, state='best'): 
500    def transformation(self, node, df, x=None, state="best"):
501        """Evaluate ``h(x | pa)`` for the rows of ``df`` (continuous nodes).
502
503        If ``x`` (1d grid) is given, returns an array ``(len(df), len(x))`` with ``h`` evaluated on
504        the grid for each row's parents; otherwise ``h`` at the observed ``df[node]``.
505        """
506        st = self.structures[node]
507        if st.target != "continuous":
508            raise ValueError("transformation() is defined for continuous nodes; use cutpoints() for ordinal ones")
509        params = self._params_for(state)[node]
510        k_min, k_max = self._minmax(node)
511        with jax.default_device(self.device):
512            enc = to_device(st.encode_frame(df, with_target=False))
513            int_out, shift_sum, _ = node_forward(st, params, enc)
514            thetas = transform_intercepts_continuous(int_out)
515            if x is None:
516                y = jnp.asarray(df[node].to_numpy(), jnp.float32)
517                return np.asarray(h_extrapolated(thetas, y, k_min, k_max) + shift_sum)
518            grid = jnp.asarray(np.asarray(x, np.float32))
519            f = jax.vmap(lambda th, s: h_extrapolated(jnp.broadcast_to(th, (grid.shape[0], th.shape[0])), grid, k_min, k_max) + s)
520            return np.asarray(f(thetas, shift_sum))

Evaluate h(x | pa) for the rows of df (continuous nodes).

If x (1d grid) is given, returns an array (len(df), len(x)) with h evaluated on the grid for each row's parents; otherwise h at the observed df[node].

def cutpoints(self, node, df, state='best'): 
522    def cutpoints(self, node, df, state="best"):
523        """Shifted cut-points ``theta_k - eta(pa)`` of an ordinal node, shape ``(len(df), K-1)``."""
524        st = self.structures[node]
525        params = self._params_for(state)[node]
526        with jax.default_device(self.device):
527            enc = to_device(st.encode_frame(df, with_target=False))
528            int_out, shift_sum, _ = node_forward(st, params, enc)
529            return np.asarray(ordinal_cutpoints(int_out) - shift_sum[:, None])

Shifted cut-points theta_k - eta(pa) of an ordinal node, shape (len(df), K-1).

def shift_term(self, node, term=0, x=None, state='best'): 
531    def shift_term(self, node, term=0, x=None, state="best"):
532        """Evaluate one shift network of ``node`` on input ``x`` (``(n, n_features)`` or 1d).
533
534        ``term`` is the index of the shift group or the name of (one of) its parents.
535        Example: inspect a learned complex shift ``cs(x2)`` of ``x3`` on a grid::
536
537            grid = np.linspace(-1, 1, 200)
538            plt.plot(grid, model.shift_term("x3", "x2", grid))
539        """
540        st = self.structures[node]
541        if isinstance(term, str):
542            idx = [i for i, g in enumerate(st.shifts) if term in g.parents]
543            if not idx:
544                raise KeyError(f"'{term}' is not a shift input of '{node}'")
545            term = idx[0]
546        g = st.shifts[term]
547        x = np.asarray(x, np.float32)
548        if x.ndim == 1:
549            x = x[:, None]
550        p = self._params_for(state)[node]["shifts"][term]
551        return np.asarray(get_model_spec(g.model_name).apply(p, jnp.asarray(x)))[:, 0]

Evaluate one shift network of node on input x ((n, n_features) or 1d).

def coefficients(self, state='best'): 
605    def coefficients(self, state="best"):
606        """Tidy table of all interpretable coefficients (linear shifts per parent / one-hot level)."""
607        rows = []
608        for n in self.order:
609            st = self.structures[n]
610            p = self._params_for(state)[n]
611            for g, sp in zip(st.shifts, p["shifts"]):
612                if not g.is_linear:
613                    continue
614                w = np.asarray(sp[0]["w"][:, 0])
615                labels = []
616                for par in g.parents:
617                    k = st.parent_levels.get(par)
618                    labels += [f"{par}={i}" for i in range(k)] if k else [par]
619                for lab, v in zip(labels, w):
620                    rows.append({"node": n, "term": "ls", "input": lab, "coefficient": float(v)})
621        return pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=["node", "term", "input", "coefficient"])

Tidy table of all interpretable coefficients (linear shifts per parent / one-hot level).

def get_train_val_nll(self, node, mode): 
623    def get_train_val_nll(self, node, mode):
624        h = self._read_histories(node)
625        if not h:
626            return None, None
627        tr, va = np.array(h["train"], float), np.array(h["val"], float)
628        if mode == "init":
629            i = 0
630        elif mode == "last":
631            i = len(tr) - 1
632        elif mode == "best":
633            i = int(np.nanargmin(va)) if np.isfinite(va).any() else int(np.nanargmin(tr))
634        else:
635            raise ValueError("mode must be one of 'best', 'last', 'init'")
636        return float(tr[i]), float(va[i])

def sample( self, do_interventions=None, predefined_latent_samples_df=None, **kwargs): 
643    def sample(self, do_interventions=None, predefined_latent_samples_df=None, **kwargs):
644        """Sample from the fitted SCM.
645
646        * observational: ``model.sample(number_of_samples=10_000)``
647        * interventional: ``model.sample(do_interventions={"x1": 0.5})``
648        * counterfactual: ``u = model.get_latent(obs_df)`` then
649          ``model.sample(do_interventions={...}, predefined_latent_samples_df=u)``
650
651        Options: ``number_of_samples`` (10 000), ``number_of_counterfactual_samples`` (10 000, draws
652        per observation for ordinal latent intervals), ``seed``, ``state`` ('best'),
653        ``use_initial_weights_for_sampling``, ``save`` (write ``sampling/sampled.npy`` per node),
654        ``verbose``. Returns ``(sampled_by_node, latents_by_node)`` with numpy arrays.
655        """
656        s = {
657            "number_of_samples": 10_000,
658            "number_of_counterfactual_samples": 10_000,
659            "seed": None,
660            "state": "best",
661            "use_initial_weights_for_sampling": False,
662            "save": True,
663            "delete_all_previously_sampled": True,
664            "verbose": self.verbose,
665            "debug": False,
666            "batch_size": None,
667            "device": None,
668        }
669        unknown = set(kwargs) - set(s)
670        if unknown:
671            raise ValueError(f"[sample] Unknown parameter(s): {', '.join(sorted(unknown))}")
672        s.update(kwargs)
673        state = "init" if s["use_initial_weights_for_sampling"] else s["state"]
674        params = self._params_for(state)
675        mm = {n: self._minmax(n) for n in self.order if self.structures[n].target == "continuous"}
676        if getattr(self, "_sampler", None) is None or self._sampler.minmax != mm:
677            self._sampler = DagSampler(self.structures, self.order, params, mm)
678        sampler = self._sampler
679        sampler.params = params
680        with jax.default_device(self.device if s["device"] is None else _resolve_device(s["device"])):
681            sampled, latents, draws = sampler.sample(
682                s["number_of_samples"], do=do_interventions, latents_df=predefined_latent_samples_df,
683                n_cf=s["number_of_counterfactual_samples"], seed=s["seed"], verbose=s["verbose"] or s["debug"],
684            )
685        self.last_counterfactual_draws = draws
686        if s["save"] and self.experiment_dir:
687            for n in self.order:
688                d = os.path.join(self._node_dir(n), "sampling")
689                if s["delete_all_previously_sampled"] and os.path.isdir(d):
690                    shutil.rmtree(d)
691                os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True)
692                if isinstance(sampled[n], dict):
693                    np.savez(os.path.join(d, "hist.npz"), **sampled[n])
694                else:
695                    np.save(os.path.join(d, "sampled.npy"), sampled[n])
696                np.save(os.path.join(d, "latents.npy"), latents[n])
697                if n in draws:
698                    np.save(os.path.join(d, "draws.npy"), draws[n])
699        return sampled, latents

Sample from the fitted SCM.

  • observational: model.sample(number_of_samples=10_000)
  • interventional: model.sample(do_interventions={"x1": 0.5})
  • counterfactual: u = model.get_latent(obs_df) then model.sample(do_interventions={...}, predefined_latent_samples_df=u)

Options: number_of_samples (10 000), number_of_counterfactual_samples (10 000, draws per observation for ordinal latent intervals), seed, state ('best'), use_initial_weights_for_sampling, save (write sampling/sampled.npy per node), verbose. Returns (sampled_by_node, latents_by_node) with numpy arrays.

def load_sampled_and_latents(self, EXPERIMENT_DIR=None, nodes=None): 
701    def load_sampled_and_latents(self, EXPERIMENT_DIR=None, nodes=None):
702        exp = EXPERIMENT_DIR or self.experiment_dir
703        sampled, latents = {}, {}
704        for n in nodes or self.order:
705            d = os.path.join(exp, n, "sampling")
706            sp, lp, hp = (os.path.join(d, f) for f in ("sampled.npy", "latents.npy", "hist.npz"))
707            if os.path.exists(sp):

709            elif os.path.exists(hp):
710                with np.load(hp) as f:
711                    sampled[n] = dict(f)
712            else:
713                print(f"[WARNING] Missing sampling files for node '{n}' — skipping.")
714                continue
715            if os.path.exists(lp):
716                latents[n] = np.load(lp)
717        return sampled, latents
def plot_loss_history(self, variable=None): 
721    def plot_loss_history(self, variable=None):
722        import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
723
724        hist = self.loss_history()
725        nodes = [variable] if variable else list(hist)
726        nodes = [n for n in nodes if hist.get(n, {}).get("train")]
727        if not nodes:
728            print("[WARNING] No valid histories found to plot.")
729            return
730        fig, axs = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(14, 12))
731        for ax, last in zip(axs, (False, True)):
732            for n in nodes:
733                tr = np.array(hist[n]["train"], float)
734                va = np.array([np.nan if v is None else v for v in (hist[n]["validation"] or [])], float)
735                E = len(tr)
736                s0 = (E - 1 if E < 5 else int(E * 0.9)) if last else 0
737                ep = np.arange(s0 + 1, E + 1)
738                ax.plot(ep, tr[s0:], "--", label=f"{n} - train")
739                if len(va):
740                    ax.plot(ep, va[s0:], label=f"{n} - val")

def plot_samples_vs_true( self, df, sampled=None, variable=None, bins=100, hist_true_color='blue', hist_est_color='orange', figsize=(14, 5)): 
853    def plot_samples_vs_true(self, df, sampled=None, variable=None, bins=100, hist_true_color="blue",
854                             hist_est_color="orange", figsize=(14, 5)):
855        import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
856        from statsmodels.graphics.gofplots import qqplot_2samples
857
858        if sampled is None:
859            sampled, _ = self.load_sampled_and_latents()
860        for n in variable or self.order:
861            if n not in sampled or n not in df.columns:
862                continue
863            sv = sampled[n]
864            if isinstance(sv, dict):
865                sv = np.repeat(sv["vals"].ravel(), sv["counts"].ravel())
866            sv = np.asarray(sv)
867            if sv.ndim == 2:
868                print(f"[INFO] CAUTION! {n}: samples are class probabilities per observation; "
869                      "the plot shows the most probable class per observation.")
870                sv = np.argmax(sv, axis=1)
871            sv = sv[np.isfinite(sv)]
872            tv = df[n].dropna().to_numpy(dtype=float)
873            tv = tv[np.isfinite(tv)]
874            fig, axs = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=figsize)
875            if self.structures[n].target == "continuous":
876                axs[0].hist(tv, bins=bins, density=True, alpha=0.6, color=hist_true_color, label=f"True {n}")
877                axs[0].hist(sv, bins=bins, density=True, alpha=0.6, color=hist_est_color, label="Sampled")
878                axs[0].set_xlabel("Value")
879                axs[0].set_ylabel("Density")
880                axs[0].set_title(f"Histogram overlay for {n}")
881                axs[0].legend()

883                qqplot_2samples(tv, sv, line="45", ax=axs[1])
884                axs[1].set_xlabel("True quantiles")
885                axs[1].set_ylabel("Sampled quantiles")
886                axs[1].set_title(f"QQ plot for {n}")
887                axs[1].grid(True, ls="--", alpha=0.4)
888            else:
889                u = np.union1d(np.unique(tv), np.unique(sv))
890                tc = np.array([(tv == v).sum() for v in u], float)
891                sc = np.array([(sv == v).sum() for v in u], float)
892                axs[0].bar(u - 0.2, tc / tc.sum(), width=0.4, color=hist_true_color, alpha=0.7, label="True")
893                axs[0].bar(u + 0.2, sc / sc.sum(), width=0.4, color=hist_est_color, alpha=0.7, label="Sampled")
894                axs[0].set_xticks(u)
895                axs[0].set_xlabel("Ordinal Level")
896                axs[0].set_ylabel("Relative Frequency")
897                axs[0].set_title(f"Ordinal bar plot for {n}")
898                axs[0].legend()
899                axs[0].grid(True, ls="--", alpha=0.4)
900                axs[1].axis("off")
901            plt.tight_layout()
902            plt.show()
